blocks.text: Accountant GuidesFind, Compare & Get MatchedEvery guide below ends the same way: tell us what you need and your area, and we’ll match you with one suitable vetted accountant. Browse by professional type, urgent problem, or research topic — then start your free match.

blocks.heading: Find the Right Professional
blocks.text: BY PROFESSIONAL TYPEFind the Right ProfessionalLooking for a specific type of accountant or bookkeeper? These guides match you with a vetted local professional whose services fit your exact needs.Accountant Near MeWhen you search 'accountant near me', you want more than the closest pin on a map — you want an accountant who actually does what you need. Your Accountant Match uses your postcode and your specific requirements to connect you with a vetted local firm.Tax Accountant Near MeA 'tax accountant near me' search should return someone who can legally lodge your return and who understands your local situation. Your Accountant Match connects you with a Tax Practitioners Board-registered tax agent in your area who specialises in exactly what you need — from a simple individual return to complex CGT, investment property and ATO dispute work.Business Accountant Near MeLooking for a local accountant for your business? Tell us your area, business type and the accounting support you need, and we'll match you with a vetted accountant from our partner network whose services fit your requirements.Bookkeeper Near MeA 'bookkeeper near me' search should return someone who knows your software, your industry and your local compliance cycle. Your Accountant Match connects you with a local registered bookkeeper (BAS Agent) who picks up your books in the platform you already use — no forced migration, no retraining your team.BAS Agent Near MeA 'BAS agent near me' search should return someone who is legally registered to lodge your BAS and who understands your industry's GST and PAYG cycle. Your Accountant Match connects you with a Tax Practitioners Board-registered BAS Agent in your area who prepares and lodges your activity statements accurately and on time — so you avoid penalties and stay current with the ATO.SMSF Accountant Near MeAn 'SMSF accountant near me' search should return a specialist who understands self-managed super compliance, not a generalist who dabbles in it. Your Accountant Match connects you with a vetted SMSF accountant in your area who handles fund setup, annual accounting and tax returns, the independent audit, and strategic advice on contributions, pensions and the Division 296 threshold.Accountant for Sole TradersRunning a business as a sole trader is simpler than a company — but the tax and compliance decisions still matter. Your Accountant Match connects you with a vetted accountant in your area who understands sole trader needs: ABN and GST registration, sole trader tax returns, BAS if you're registered for GST, and advice on when structuring as a company or trust might save you tax.Accountant for Companies & Small BusinessesA company or small business brings real compliance obligations — corporate tax returns, director duties, payroll and super, financial statements, and ASIC lodgements. Your Accountant Match connects you with a vetted accountant in your area who specialises in company and small business accounting: accurate returns, proactive tax planning, and advice on structure, growth and cash flow.PROBLEM & URGENT HELPCatch Up on Overdue Tax & ATO MattersBehind on a return, BAS or facing ATO contact? These guides connect you with a registered agent who can bring you current and deal with the ATO on your behalf.Overdue Tax Return HelpHave one or more overdue tax returns? A registered tax agent can help bring your lodgements up to date, deal with the ATO on your behalf and, where applicable, request penalty remission or help arrange a payment plan for tax debt. Your Accountant Match connects you with a vetted registered tax agent experienced in overdue and late tax returns.ATO Audit HelpAn ATO audit or review is stressful — but you do not have to face it alone. A registered tax agent can manage the ATO's correspondence, prepare the requested information, negotiate outcomes, and lodge objections on your behalf. Your Accountant Match connects you with a local agent experienced in ATO audits, disputes and debt matters.Late BAS HelpBehind on one or more BAS lodgements? A registered BAS agent can help prepare and lodge overdue activity statements, reconcile GST and PAYG information, deal with the ATO, request remission of penalties or interest where appropriate, and help arrange a payment plan if required. Your Accountant Match connects you with a vetted registered agent experienced in overdue BAS and catch-up bookkeeping.RESEARCH & GUIDESUnderstand Costs, Compare Options & Key DatesResearching before you engage? Compare real 2026 accountant fees, understand the difference between an accountant and a bookkeeper, and keep track of every important tax deadline — before you decide.How Much Does an Accountant CostAccountant fees in Australia vary depending on the service, complexity and expertise you need. Compare typical 2026 costs for individual tax returns, BAS, small business accounting, SMSF accounting and specialist advice — then get matched with a vetted accountant suited to your needs.Accountant vs BookkeeperNot sure whether you need an accountant or a bookkeeper? A bookkeeper typically handles your day-to-day financial records, while an accountant focuses on tax, compliance, structure and forward planning. This Australian guide explains the difference, when you may need each, and when one firm can provide both.Important Tax DatesMissing a tax deadline rarely causes an immediate crisis — but the penalties, interest and default assessments that follow are entirely avoidable when you know the dates that apply to you. This guide brings together the key Australian tax deadlines for individuals, businesses, BAS lodgers, superannuation and companies or trusts in one place, updated for the 2026 financial year. Check what applies to you, then get matched with a vetted local accountant who can keep you on time.BY LOCATIONFind an Accountant in Your CityWe match individuals and businesses with vetted local accountants across Australia. links.text: Accountant Near MeWhen you search 'accountant near me', you want more than the closest pin on a map — you want an accountant who actually does what you need. Your Accountant Match uses your postcode and your specific requirements to connect you with a vetted local firm.

Tax Accountant Near MeA 'tax accountant near me' search should return someone who can legally lodge your return and who understands your local situation. Your Accountant Match connects you with a Tax Practitioners Board-registered tax agent in your area who specialises in exactly what you need — from a simple individual return to complex CGT, investment property and ATO dispute work.

Business Accountant Near MeLooking for a local accountant for your business? Tell us your area, business type and the accounting support you need, and we'll match you with a vetted accountant from our partner network whose services fit your requirements.

Bookkeeper Near MeA 'bookkeeper near me' search should return someone who knows your software, your industry and your local compliance cycle. Your Accountant Match connects you with a local registered bookkeeper (BAS Agent) who picks up your books in the platform you already use — no forced migration, no retraining your team.

BAS Agent Near MeA 'BAS agent near me' search should return someone who is legally registered to lodge your BAS and who understands your industry's GST and PAYG cycle. Your Accountant Match connects you with a Tax Practitioners Board-registered BAS Agent in your area who prepares and lodges your activity statements accurately and on time — so you avoid penalties and stay current with the ATO.

SMSF Accountant Near MeAn 'SMSF accountant near me' search should return a specialist who understands self-managed super compliance, not a generalist who dabbles in it. Your Accountant Match connects you with a vetted SMSF accountant in your area who handles fund setup, annual accounting and tax returns, the independent audit, and strategic advice on contributions, pensions and the Division 296 threshold.

Accountant for Sole TradersRunning a business as a sole trader is simpler than a company — but the tax and compliance decisions still matter. Your Accountant Match connects you with a vetted accountant in your area who understands sole trader needs: ABN and GST registration, sole trader tax returns, BAS if you're registered for GST, and advice on when structuring as a company or trust might save you tax.

Accountant for Companies & Small BusinessesA company or small business brings real compliance obligations — corporate tax returns, director duties, payroll and super, financial statements, and ASIC lodgements. Your Accountant Match connects you with a vetted accountant in your area who specialises in company and small business accounting: accurate returns, proactive tax planning, and advice on structure, growth and cash flow.

Overdue Tax Return HelpHave one or more overdue tax returns? A registered tax agent can help bring your lodgements up to date, deal with the ATO on your behalf and, where applicable, request penalty remission or help arrange a payment plan for tax debt. Your Accountant Match connects you with a vetted registered tax agent experienced in overdue and late tax returns.

ATO Audit HelpAn ATO audit or review is stressful — but you do not have to face it alone. A registered tax agent can manage the ATO's correspondence, prepare the requested information, negotiate outcomes, and lodge objections on your behalf. Your Accountant Match connects you with a local agent experienced in ATO audits, disputes and debt matters.

Late BAS HelpBehind on one or more BAS lodgements? A registered BAS agent can help prepare and lodge overdue activity statements, reconcile GST and PAYG information, deal with the ATO, request remission of penalties or interest where appropriate, and help arrange a payment plan if required. Your Accountant Match connects you with a vetted registered agent experienced in overdue BAS and catch-up bookkeeping.

How Much Does an Accountant CostAccountant fees in Australia vary depending on the service, complexity and expertise you need. Compare typical 2026 costs for individual tax returns, BAS, small business accounting, SMSF accounting and specialist advice — then get matched with a vetted accountant suited to your needs.

Accountant vs BookkeeperNot sure whether you need an accountant or a bookkeeper? A bookkeeper typically handles your day-to-day financial records, while an accountant focuses on tax, compliance, structure and forward planning. This Australian guide explains the difference, when you may need each, and when one firm can provide both.

Important Tax DatesMissing a tax deadline rarely causes an immediate crisis — but the penalties, interest and default assessments that follow are entirely avoidable when you know the dates that apply to you. This guide brings together the key Australian tax deadlines for individuals, businesses, BAS lodgers, superannuation and companies or trusts in one place, updated for the 2026 financial year. Check what applies to you, then get matched with a vetted local accountant who can keep you on time.
